Zoe K: Heads-up: hiring managers for REQ-721 noticed scorecards missing the new leadership questions when opening candidate panels this morning.
Miguel H: Which template/version were they expecting?
Zoe K: We rolled out scorecard v2 last week (added leadership + influence section) but panels are showing v1.
Priya N: Recruiters exported the panel with `scorecard_template_id=ext-47` which we thought mapped to v2. Looks like `ext-47` now points to v1 in ATS after a template rename.
Ben L: Oof. We changed the internal `template_id` mapping logic during the last migration; external IDs and internal versions got decoupled.
Sam P: Any error logs during attach step?
ats-sync-bot: [08:04] scorecard-attach job: WARN row 3: template ext-47 resolved to internal_template_id=127 (version=1)
Miguel H: So the attach step happily attached v1 because it resolved to that internal id. We need to re-resolve by canonical template name + version tag, not just ext id.
Zoe K: Interviews start tomorrow; interviewers will be using outdated rubric unless we fix and backfill.
Ben L: Short-term fix: remap ext-47 to the internal id for v2, and run a reattach job for open panels where version < 2. I'll add a safety check to ensure we don't overwrite panels that recruiters intentionally pinned.
Priya N: Is there a risk of double-notifying interviewers if we reattach?
Sam P: The attach job is idempotent if `scorecard_version` differs; we trigger an update event but we can suppress email notifications for reattaches by passing `notify=false` in the backfill command.
Miguel H: I'll prepare the remapping SQL: `UPDATE template_mappings SET internal_id = 198 WHERE external_id = 'ext-47' AND namespace='scorecard' AND internal_version = 2;` then reattach with `./bin/reattach-scorecards --req REQ-721 --force-version 2 --notify=false`.
Zoe K: Can you scope the backfill to only open panels and only if current version < 2? We don't want to touch completed panels.
Ben L: Yes, backfill will filter `panel_state IN ('open','scheduled') AND scorecard_version < 2`.
ats-sync-bot: [08:27] patch deployed: template mapping updated for ext-47 -> internal_id=198 (version=2)
Ben L: starting backfill job bf-2287654321-1 with notify=false
Recruiter Bot: manual trigger: queued reattach job for REQ-721 by Priya N
ats-sync-bot: [08:39] backfill bf-2287654321-1 finished: 8 scorecards reattached, 0 failures, 2 panels skipped (pinned by recruiter)
Priya N: Confirmed recruiters see the v2 rubric now for the 8 updated panels. Two pinned panels left alone as requested.
Zoe K: Thanks team. Quick follow-ups: add a pre-import check that verifies external->internal template mapping version parity and warn in Slack if mismatched.
Miguel H: Will do. I'll add a mapping validation step in the import pipeline that posts to #people-ops with `template_ext, expected_version, resolved_version` when they differ.
Ben L: Also adding unit tests for mapping logic and a safe-guard in the backfill CLI that requires `--force` to touch panels with state not in (open,scheduled).
Sam P: And I'll update Recruiting Ops runbook with the steps we just executed (mapping SQL, reattach CLI, notification flag).
Zoe K: Can we also add an alert if >1% of newly attached scorecards are version < expected in a 1h window so we catch divergent mappings early?
Miguel H: Yep, adding a Datadog monitor and a Slack pager to #people-ops.
Priya N: Closing loop. I'll message hiring managers to confirm everything looks correct. Thanks all :thumbsup:
